Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for me! Single, female home owner who loves grilling. This little guy makes grilling easy and simple. No bells and whistles, just simple gas grilling at it's best! Two knobs to adjust the temp, one push button start and your up and running! No crazy waiting for it to heat up, no fancy starters or smoking temps...simple. I love grilled salmon and have it at least twice a week. Fire this bad boy up and in about 5 . minutes it's ready to go. Easy clean up, and fits enough for a cookout for 7-10 people. Highly recommend getting the cover also. I haven't owned many grills in my life but I'd buy this one again tomorrow if it ever broke...but it won't, it's a Weber! My father's Weber is almost 20 years old and runs like the day he bought it. Easy to assemble and perfect for the corner spot in the deck.  Even if you don't buy this exact model, buy a Weber. You won't be disappointed!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I'm a 65 year old man and have been grilling since my 20's, so a long time.  I've used all kind of grills from charcoal grills to cheap gas grills to medium priced gas grills.  I've always been leery of purchasing a Weber due to the high price, figuring that all grills pretty much did the same thing.  I couldn't have been more wrong and am so glad I spent the extra money this time around.

The Spirit II E-210 gets up to grilling temperature twice as fast as my previous grill, maintains even heat throughout the cooking process and cooks much more quickly than any grill I've ever owned. This grill produces DELICIOUS food, not me - I do the same thing I've always done but the food is WAY BETTER.

I highly recommend this grill!

Results.Title: My first Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit E-210 three weeks ago. It heats up very quickly. I like the even cooking heat that it provides. There are no cool spots which makes grilling easy. Even though it’s nit a large grill, I am able to use the entire surface to grill. Also, being a 2 burner grill, I use less gas. I am also sold on the 10 year warranty which demonstrates that Weber stands behind its products.
Results.Title: Great value

Results.ReviewText: Nothing fancy with this unit. Heats up fast and cooks just like you want a grill to cook. If it last like everyone I know that owns a Webber this is a great purchase.
Results.Title: Good unit for a good price.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The only issue I have at this time is it takes quite a while to light the grill. The gas is on and I keep my finger on the starter button nothing happens for 10-15 seconds. Then it slightly flairs up and starts.
Results.Title: Easy to put together and grill with

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This Weber Spirit replaces the older Spirit Weber purchased years ago.  I trust the Weber brand. It is reliable and durable. The heat is even although this new one heats quicker than the old one. My only suggestion would be to go back to having doors rather than a complete open area since the racoons like to steal the grease tray.
Results.Title: Super Efficient BBQ

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The weather hasn't been good enough to use it fully, but I have enjoyed this EVERY TIME. I really like the access to the Weber website that provides hints on best ways to prepare different selections. Great to make use of the indirect cooking! The balanced and secure heat makes this a great option.
Results.Title: Great Grill...Perfect Size!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
